extension_rule: If any method/domain improves strictly more than 0.3 deg from 27500 to 30000, all three extend to 50000. No further automatic extension.
budget_rule: Smallest evaluated B < T: absolute MAE difference to that method/domain at T <=0.3 for all nine cells, and all per-domain pairwise rank signatures agree between B and B+2500. T=30000, or 50000 when extension triggered.
no_qualifying_B: inconclusive; formal grid stays locked; never invent a final-point successor
still_improving_at_50000: inconclusive if any 47500-to-50000 improvement >0.3; formal grid stays locked
overfit_warning: Report validation rise >0.3 above its earlier minimum plus falling fixed-training-probe MAE for the same source domain; NYUv2 has no training probe. Warning is separate from the budget rule and cannot silently change it.

train_probe.selection: SHA256 rank of source domain and stable image key with fixed prefix train-probe-v1, training split only, no loss-based selection

extension_schedule: Keep the original 30000-step cosine schedule. For updates 30001..50000 hold LR at the 30000-step floor (0.1 * base LR). Restore optimizer and all RNG states from final resume checkpoint. Do not replay the cosine or restart training.
formal_training: Separate reviewed configuration and fresh shared initialization; no automatic 24-run launch. Budget selection from continuation curves does not make them identical to a fresh B-step cosine run.
